<tspan x="689.0" dy="0">E### = source span (hover a module); dashed = named state / auxiliary input; fork-join = tuple/list, not sum.</tspan>
</text>

<tspan x="689.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>
